summary: Iteration 7: tested Food Cost (/t/food-cost API + /food-cost UI), stock restore on order cancel (ripristino scorte), invoice OCR scan (real Gemini call, JPEG+PNG+blank+non-image) and apply (mixed existing/new/skipped lines, supplier create/reuse), staff permissions, tenant isolation, and the Magazzino 'Scansiona fattura' UI end-to-end. Backend 11/13 pass. Core flows all work: food-cost math/summary right, restore 8.2->9.1 exact + idempotent (re-cancel and nuovo->annullato again give a single 'reso'), served orders not restored, OCR reads supplier/date (2026-01-15)/doc no./qty/unit/unit_cost correctly in ~5-10s and auto-matches by substring, apply updates cost, creates the new ingredient with the right category/unit/cost, adds stock (carico) and creates/links the supplier (case-insensitive reuse). 2 backend failures: unescaped supplier regex returns 500, and staff can open food-cost. UI: full owner flow works (upload -> editable lines -> match -> apply -> list refreshes, Zucchine 1->7kg @2.40, Rucola created). 2 UI bugs: match dropdown is empty when a category filter is active, and margin sort is misleading.

critical.issue: supplier_name goes into a Mongo $regex without re.escape. Names with regex characters ('[', '(', '+', '*', '.') cause a 500 (pymongo OperationFailure: missing terminating ]) or a wrong match/duplicate supplier ('Rossi (srl)' never matches itself; 'S.r.l.' dots match any character). OCR returns names like 'Ortofrutta Bianchi S.r.l.' as normal output, so this will happen.

minor.issue: Uses require_tenant() with no role, so staff get 200 and see the cost/margin of every dish. The review spec says food-cost needs at least manager. The frontend nav also shows Food Cost to staff. Use require_tenant('manager') and hide nav-food-cost for staff, or confirm this is intended.
For existing ingredients the line unit is ignored. A 'cf' invoice line mapped to a 'kg' ingredient adds the raw qty with no conversion or warning.

Auto-match is plain substring matching in both directions. Short ingredient names can cause false positives. No fuzzy or word-based match: 'TEST_Zucchine' did not match the OCR result 'Zucchine Romanesche'.
Items with a recipe but price 0 are counted under 'without_recipe' in the summary.

ui_bugs.issue: InvoiceSheet gets ingredients={list}, which is the filtered/searched list. With a category filter on (e.g. 'Carne'), the auto-matched ingredient is not among the Select options, so the trigger shows blank and only 'Crea nuovo ingrediente' is listed. Reproduced. Fix: pass a separate unfiltered ingredient list.

Backend returns margin=price for dishes with no recipe (cost 0), so 'Margine' sorting puts recipe-less dishes (Cotoletta 24€, Tagliata 22€...) above real ones even though their margin shows '—'. Put has_recipe=false rows last.

Line name is not editable, so a new ingredient is created with the raw OCR name. The unit is a free-text Input instead of a Select of UNITS. Delete-line button and new-category Select have no data-testid.

issues: max-w-5xl leaves about 40% of the 1920px screen empty on the right
No error state: if the API fails the page stays on 'Caricamento…' forever (only a toast)
New ingredients from OCR default to category 'Altro'. Consider asking the LLM for a category suggestion.

action_items: Escape the supplier name in apply_invoice: {'$regex': f'^{re.escape(name)}$', '$options': 'i'} (also check other $regex uses on user input, e.g. ingredients q search)
InvoiceSheet: pass an unfiltered ingredient list (fetch /t/ingredients without params when the sheet opens) so auto-match and manual mapping work with filters active
FoodCost margin sort: put has_recipe=false items last (or have the backend return margin=null for them)
Decide the food-cost permission: require manager on GET /t/food-cost and hide nav-food-cost for staff, per the spec
Optional: editable line name, unit Select, data-testids on the line delete button and category select, an error state on the FoodCost page
critical_code_review_comments: routers/inventory.py apply_invoice: unescaped regex (500 / wrong supplier match)
routers/inventory.py list_ingredients: q goes into $regex unescaped too (same class of bug, pre-existing)

restore_for_order is correctly idempotent through the 'reso' marker. Side effect: an order cancelled, reopened (nuovo) and cancelled again stays restored once, but its stock is not depleted again on reopen. Acceptable but worth documenting.
ocr.py: a new LlmChat per call with a fixed session_id 'invoice-ocr' is fine (no shared history). The blank image returns 200 with lines=[] and the UI shows 'Nessuna riga.'

success_rate.frontend: 80% (owner flow ok; filtered-list match bug, margin sort bug)

seed_data_creation: Temporary ingredients (Zucchine, Rucola Selvatica, TEST_*), the suppliers they created and staff users were cleaned up. TEST tenants (test-fc-*) created by the superadmin were deactivated. The demo item Pizza Margherita recipe was restored after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://ristoos.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest test_iteration7_foodcost_ocr.py -q -n 0. make_invoice.make(path, supplier, lines) builds a PIL invoice image. Gemini drops the 'TEST_' prefix from item names, so the match test uses an ingredient named 'Zucchine' (deleted in teardown). The scan test does NOT apply, so the demo 'Pomodoro' is not touched. UI: invoice-btn -> set_input_files('[data-testid=invoice-file-input]') -> wait for invoice-apply-btn (up to ~15s). Retest: special-char supplier, filtered-list match, margin sort, staff food-cost.
rca of the issue: 1) 500 on apply: supplier_name is interpolated raw into the regex '^...$', so Mongo rejects an invalid pattern (code 51091). Repro: POST /t/invoices/apply {supplier_name:'TEST_Rossi (srl) [ab', lines:[{ingredient_id:<id>, name:'x', qty:1}]} returns 500. Mitigation: re.escape. 2) Empty match dropdown: Inventory.jsx line 275 passes the filtered `list` state to InvoiceSheet. Repro: Magazzino -> click the 'Carne' chip -> Scansiona fattura -> upload an invoice with a Verdura item: the trigger is blank. Mitigation: use a separate full ingredient list.
